# Method IsSketchDeferred

#### IsSketchDeferred(ElementId)

Checks if the sketch operation is deferred.

##### Declaration

```
[OperationContract]
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 18, 400, 200)]
bool IsSketchDeferred(ElementId inElementId)
```

##### Parameters

|  Type |  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | --- | 
   
|  ElementId |  inElementId |  sketch operation to check.  |  

##### Returns

|  Type |  Description |  
| --- | --- | 
   
|  bool |  True if the given element is a deferred sketch operation.  |
